latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of job-search-report: generates a detailed job search progress report from Gmail data.
- Detects and summarizes job applications sent and recruiter replies within the last 90 days.
- Cross-references applications and replies to map statuses (active, in progress, no reply, rejections).
- Produces a structured, markdown-formatted report including overview metrics, categorized company lists, timeline view, and insights.
- Provides options to save the report as a markdown file or Google Doc.
- Supports weekly update mode, showing only new changes since last report.
